sphinx

sphinx builds this shape of page. The readable part is the rst-content block, not the side navigation.

A definition list, a table and a code block are all part of the manual. The reader keeps their text.

root

chrome

make html

The word sphinx in the title is the marker the host test looks for. It has to survive the reduce step.
